settings.heading: Let’s get you to the right place.
settings.intro: A few details make an enquiry easier to understand.

settings.question: Asking about a product?
settings.answer: Include the product name or page link, and the size, pack or compatibility detail you want to check. The current illustrated products are samples, not live stock.

settings.question: Asking about delivery?
settings.answer: Tell us the Dubai area you have in mind. Delivery coverage and timings are still being finalised; this preview does not confirm serviceability.

settings.question: Something on the site isn’t working?
settings.answer: Tell us which page you were on and what you expected to happen. Your device and browser name are useful too.

settings.question: What should I leave out of my message?
settings.answer: Please do not send card numbers, passwords or one-time login codes. A product link and a clear description are enough to begin.
